name: Notification passthrough tmux routing build validation

description: Build: route `cmux notify` through caller-aware notification path so tmux invocations include pane metadata; document tmux OSC 777 limitation and direct CLI mechanism.

asi.hypothesis: Using the existing caller-aware notification.create_for_caller helper from `cmux notify` will attach tmux pane metadata and route rich notifications from processes inside tmux to the originating cmux pane, avoiding the payload-less forwarded bell path.

description: Build: improve `cmux notify` ergonomics for tmux-safe rich notifications by accepting `--message` and positional body text while preserving caller-aware tmux pane routing.

asi.hypothesis: Lowering friction for arbitrary scripts and CLIs inside tmux makes the socket-based rich notification path more broadly usable than OSC/bell forwarding; accepting `cmux notify --title X 'body'` and `--message` keeps routing through caller-aware tmux metadata without requiring terminal escape sequences.
asi.next_action_hint: Consider adding CI/VM behavioral coverage for `cmux notify --title X body` once socket CLI tests are run in the approved environment.

asi.hypothesis: Installing tmux bridge hooks with an absolute bundled/current cmux CLI path would make alert forwarding robust even when tmux hook execution has a different PATH.

asi.next_action_hint: Free or reuse package artifact cache / derived data, then retry the same low-risk CLI hook path change.

description: Build: make installed tmux bridge hooks use cmux's bundled/current CLI path instead of relying on `cmux` being on tmux hook PATH.

asi.hypothesis: Using an absolute bundled/current cmux CLI path in managed tmux alert hooks makes notification forwarding more reliable for processes inside tmux, because hooks can still call `cmux hooks feed` when tmux's noninteractive PATH cannot resolve `cmux`.
asi.validation: ./scripts/reload.sh --tag notification-passthrough-notify-ergonomics passed using existing derived data cache after prior disk-full artifact extraction crash

description: Build: embed the current cmux socket path in installed tmux bridge hooks so alert forwarding does not depend on tmux preserving `CMUX_SOCKET_PATH`.

asi.hypothesis: Embedding `--socket <current CMUX_SOCKET_PATH>` in managed tmux bridge hooks makes notification forwarding more robust for long-lived tmux servers and noninteractive hook shells whose environment may lose cmux variables, while preserving the absolute CLI path fallback from the previous iteration.

description: Build: let `cmux notify` use piped stdin as the notification body when no explicit body argument is provided, improving tmux-safe rich notification ergonomics for shell pipelines.

asi.hypothesis: Allowing `make 2>&1 | cmux notify --title ...` to read stdin makes the socket-based rich notification path easy for arbitrary scripts inside tmux and avoids OSC/bell payload loss without adding process-specific integrations.

description: Build: include tmux pane title and window name in managed tmux bridge notifications for richer context when only tmux alert hooks are available.

asi.hypothesis: Even when tmux consumes OSC notification payloads, tmux often retains pane title/window-name context. Forwarding that metadata through managed alert hooks gives cmux notifications more meaningful content than a generic bell/activity message without modifying Ghostty or relying on process-specific integrations.

description: Build: include tmux pane current directory in managed tmux bridge notification bodies for additional context when OSC notification payloads are unavailable.

asi.hypothesis: When tmux consumes rich OSC notification payloads, pane_current_path is still available from tmux hook formats and helps users identify which project/worktree emitted the bell or activity alert without needing Ghostty changes.

description: Build: cap piped stdin bodies for `cmux notify` before sending notifications over the socket, preventing accidental oversized notifications from large command logs.

asi.hypothesis: Piped command output is useful for tmux-safe rich notifications, but unbounded stdin can turn large logs into oversized socket payloads and notification bodies. Capping stdin keeps the general workflow safe without weakening explicit --body/positional usage.

description: Build: preserve the tail of piped stdin for `cmux notify` instead of the head when truncating large command output, so notifications show the most recent log context.

asi.hypothesis: For tmux-safe notifications fed from command pipelines, the tail of a large log usually contains the actionable failure/success context. Keeping the last 16 KB maintains bounded socket payloads while making stdin notifications more useful than head-only truncation.

description: Build: support explicit stdin body syntax for `cmux notify --body -` and `--message -`, matching common CLI conventions for tmux-safe rich notifications.

asi.hypothesis: Adding explicit `--body -` / `--message -` support makes the socket-based notification path easier to integrate into existing shell scripts that use dash as stdin convention, while reusing the capped tail-reading behavior from prior iterations.

description: Build: add `cmux notify --body-file <path|->` so scripts can send rich tmux-safe notifications from log files while reusing capped tail reads.

asi.hypothesis: Many scripts already write logs to files rather than pipelines. Supporting `--body-file` gives a process-agnostic tmux-safe notification path for those scripts, preserving recent output via the same last-16KB cap used for stdin.

description: Build: optimize `cmux notify --body-file` for large regular files by seeking directly to the last 16 KB instead of streaming the whole file.

asi.hypothesis: Since notification file bodies intentionally preserve only recent output, regular log files can be tailed directly with FileHandle.seek rather than fully streamed. This keeps the tmux-safe log-file notification workflow scalable for large build logs without changing observable body limits.

description: Build: add `cmux notify --body-max-bytes` to tune capped stdin/file notification body size while enforcing a 64 KB socket-payload ceiling.

asi.hypothesis: Different scripts need different amounts of log context. A bounded `--body-max-bytes` option keeps socket payloads safe while letting tmux-safe notifications include shorter or richer stdin/file tails as appropriate.

description: Build: make explicit stdin notification bodies (`--body -`, `--message -`, `--body-file -`) fail fast on terminal stdin instead of silently sending an empty body or blocking.

asi.hypothesis: Explicit dash stdin means the caller expects piped or redirected content. Failing fast when stdin is a terminal prevents confusing empty notifications for `--body -` and avoids interactive hangs for `--body-file -`, improving script ergonomics for tmux-safe notifications.

description: Build: include tmux pane/window context directly in managed bridge notification titles, so alerts are meaningful even before reading the body.

asi.hypothesis: The original tmux problem included an unhelpful title like `tmux`. Managed tmux bridge alerts already forward pane/window metadata, so folding that context into the notification title makes bell/activity/silence alerts recognizable at a glance without relying on body expansion.

description: Build: keep tmux bridge notification titles concise by truncating pane/window context to 80 characters while preserving full context in the body.

asi.hypothesis: Adding pane/window context to tmux bridge notification titles improves recognizability, but unbounded pane titles can make macOS notifications noisy. Truncating only the title context keeps alerts glanceable while retaining full metadata in the body.

description: Build: use tmux pane/window/command metadata as the default `cmux notify` title inside tmux when `--title` is omitted, avoiding generic Notification titles.

asi.hypothesis: The original tmux issue produced unhelpful titles such as `tmux`. For direct `cmux notify` calls without an explicit title, tmux already exposes pane/window/command metadata; using that as a fallback keeps notifications meaningful without requiring every script to provide a title.

description: Build: reuse concise 80-character tmux metadata title handling for direct `cmux notify` default titles inside tmux.

asi.hypothesis: The previous default-title fallback for direct `cmux notify` inside tmux could inherit arbitrarily long pane/window titles. Reusing the concise title context logic keeps both direct and bridge notifications glanceable while preserving meaningful tmux metadata.

description: Build: use tmux session/window/pane location as the default `cmux notify` subtitle inside tmux when `--subtitle` is omitted.

asi.hypothesis: Direct `cmux notify` calls inside tmux now get better default titles, but notifications still lose location context if the script omits `--subtitle`. Filling the subtitle from tmux session/window/pane metadata makes routed notifications easier to identify without requiring script-specific integrations.

description: Build: add tmux command/current-directory fallback body for direct `cmux notify` calls inside tmux when no body content is provided.

asi.hypothesis: A direct `cmux notify` call inside tmux with no body can still be useful if it carries command and directory context from tmux. This avoids empty notification bodies and gives generic scripts a meaningful, process-agnostic fallback without touching Ghostty or relying on OSC payloads.

description: Build crash: attempted to batch direct tmux notify metadata defaults into one tmux query, but Swift compile failed due optional output handling before validation.

asi.hypothesis: Batching pane/window/command/session/path metadata into one tmux display-message call would reduce process launches for direct `cmux notify` defaults inside tmux.
asi.rollback_reason: Swift compile error: optional String from runTmuxForHook handling was not unwrapped before components(separatedBy:).
asi.next_action_hint: Retry the same optimization with explicit fallback `?? ""` before splitting the tmux output.

description: Build: batch direct tmux `cmux notify` default title/subtitle/body metadata into a single `tmux display-message` query.

asi.hypothesis: Direct `cmux notify` defaults inside tmux now use pane/window/command/session/path metadata, but fetching each field separately launches several tmux processes. Batching the metadata into one display-message call preserves behavior while reducing overhead for scripts that omit title/subtitle/body.
asi.validation: ./scripts/reload.sh --tag notification-passthrough-notify-ergonomics passed after retry with optional output fallback

description: Build: lazily fetch batched tmux metadata defaults for direct `cmux notify`, avoiding tmux queries when title/subtitle/body are explicitly supplied.

asi.hypothesis: Batched tmux defaults reduced multiple process launches to one, but direct notifications with explicit title/subtitle/body do not need the tmux defaults at all. Lazy loading preserves fallback behavior while removing unnecessary tmux work for fully specified notifications.

description: Build: batch tmux caller-routing metadata into one query for `cmux notify` and other caller-aware socket commands.

asi.hypothesis: Direct `cmux notify` now lazily batches default text metadata, but caller-aware routing still launched several tmux display-message commands to attach pane TTY/id/session/window/command metadata. Batching those routing fields into one tmux query preserves pane routing while reducing overhead for tmux-originated notifications and status updates.

description: Build: relabel generic Ghostty bell fallback for tmux-titled panes so tmux alerts no longer display only `Terminal bell`.

asi.hypothesis: The user still sees `Terminal bell` because tmux can forward a payload-less bell through Ghostty before or instead of cmux's richer tmux bridge path. Detecting tmux-titled panes in the generic bell handler and labeling the fallback as `Bell received from tmux` makes the visible notification accurate and avoids the misleading terminal-bell text, while docs explain that this path means the original title/body payload was not recoverable.

description: Build: make cmux notify fall back to terminal escape notification (OSC 777 with DCS wrapping) when socket is unavailable inside tmux, so notifications still work in real tmux sessions without cmux socket access.

asi.hypothesis: When cmux notify fails to connect to the socket inside tmux, fall back to notify-terminal behavior (OSC 777 with DCS wrapping) so notifications still work in real tmux sessions where cmux socket is unreachable
